SD: Number of data points (n)

Total number of observations. With FreqOn this is the sum of frequencies, not the number of distinct x-values.

n is the sample size. Each DT with frequency 1 adds 1. With FreqOn, entering x ; f DT adds f to n. Line = on the editor is the number of stored records (pairs or points), which can be smaller than n when frequencies are greater than 1.

formula
n=∑fi​
FreqOff: each point has fi​=1
keys
SHIFT→1→3→EXE

Example

Data: 2, 4, 6, 8 (four numbers)
n = 4
steps

On the calculator

  1. MODE→1→EXE (4. If you were already in SD, SHIFT 9 (Stat) to clear the old list)
  2. 2→DT
  3. 4→DT
  4. 6→DT
  5. 8→DT
  6. then AC
  7. SHIFT→1→3→EXE→n = 4

Example with frequencies (FreqOn)

Three class rows (75, 80, 85):

75 appears once
80 appears twice
85 appears four times
n = 1 + 2 + 4 = 7
not 3 (the number of rows)
steps

On the calculator

  1. Confirm FreqOn in SETUP, then MODE 4
  2. 75→DT
  3. 80→DT→DT
  4. 85 ; 4 DT
  5. then AC
  6. SHIFT→1→3→EXE→n = 7
note

The calculator keeps n as it builds the list. Arithmetic mean (x̄) and Standard deviation (σx / sx) are then worked out from n, Σx, and Σx². Sample standard deviation (sx) needs at least two data points.
